import { isJsonNumber, validate as validateContent, } from '@omne-harness-lite/content-blocks';
import { OPAQUE_IDENTIFIER_WHITESPACE_CODE_POINTS, parseScopeLayerIdentity, tenantIdEquals, } from '@omne-harness-lite/identity-values';
import { validate as validateExpiry } from '@omne-harness-lite/offer-expiry';
import { isObject, isStringArray, jsonValue } from "./json.js";
import { compareNumbers, isPositiveInteger } from "./numbers.js";
import { malformedParameters, parametersOutOfRange } from "./parameters.js";
import { validate } from "./schema.js";
const contentMembers = [
    'routeName',
    'origin',
    'providers',
    'allowFallback',
    'inputModalities',
    'outputModalities',
    'maxInputTokens',
    'maxOutputTokens',
    'inputConstraints',
];
const profileMembers = [...contentMembers, 'registration', 'updatedAt'];
/** S-25: check all malformed conditions before any of the nine named predicates. */
export function judgeModelProfileDocument(kind, value) {
    const document = jsonValue(value);
    if (!isObject(document) || malformed(kind, document))
        return rejected('malformed');
    if (kind === 'ModelRequestParameters') {
        return parametersOutOfRange(document)
            ? rejected('parameter_out_of_range')
            : Object.freeze({ ok: true });
    }
    if (document.routeName === '')
        return rejected('route_name_empty');
    if (kind === 'ModelProfileRef')
        return Object.freeze({ ok: true });
    if (isStringArray(document.providers) && document.providers.length === 0)
        return rejected('providers_empty');
    const input = document.inputModalities;
    const output = document.outputModalities;
    if (isStringArray(input) && isStringArray(output)) {
        if (input.length === 0 || output.length === 0)
            return rejected('modalities_empty');
        if (!input.includes('text'))
            return rejected('input_text_missing');
        if ([...input, ...output].some(item => !validateContent('Modality', item).valid))
            return rejected('modality_unknown');
    }
    if (kind === 'ModelProfile' &&
        document.registration !== 'listed' &&
        document.registration !== 'withdrawn')
        return rejected('registration_unknown');
    const params = document.parameters;
    if (isObject(params)) {
        if (parametersOutOfRange(params))
            return rejected('parameter_out_of_range');
        if (isJsonNumber(params.maxOutputTokens) &&
            isJsonNumber(document.maxOutputTokens) &&
            compareNumbers(params.maxOutputTokens, document.maxOutputTokens) > 0)
            return rejected('max_output_exceeds_profile');
    }
    if (isObject(document.inputConstraints) &&
        Object.keys(document.inputConstraints).some(key => key !== 'maxImageBytes'))
        return rejected('constraint_unknown');
    // This is an invariant check on the implementation, not a fallback error classifier.
    if (!validate(kind, document).valid)
        throw new Error('model-profile predicates disagree with owned Schema');
    return Object.freeze({ ok: true });
}
function malformed(kind, value) {
    if (kind === 'ModelRequestParameters')
        return malformedParameters(value, false);
    if (typeof value.routeName !== 'string' ||
        (value.origin !== 'official' && value.origin !== 'custom'))
        return true;
    if (routeWhitespace(value.routeName))
        return true;
    if (kind === 'ModelProfileRef') {
        const members = value.origin === 'official' ? ['origin', 'routeName'] : ['origin', 'scope', 'routeName'];
        if (!hasMembers(value, members, members))
            return true;
        return value.origin === 'custom' && !('ok' in parseScopeLayerIdentity(value.scope));
    }
    const required = kind === 'ModelProfile' ? profileMembers : contentMembers;
    if (!hasMembers(value, required, [...required, 'parameters']))
        return true;
    if (typeof value.allowFallback !== 'boolean')
        return true;
    for (const name of ['providers', 'inputModalities', 'outputModalities']) {
        const items = value[name];
        if (!isStringArray(items) || new Set(items).size !== items.length)
            return true;
        if (name === 'providers' && items.some(item => item === ''))
            return true;
    }
    if (!isPositiveInteger(value.maxInputTokens) || !isPositiveInteger(value.maxOutputTokens))
        return true;
    if (!isObject(value.inputConstraints))
        return true;
    if (Object.hasOwn(value.inputConstraints, 'maxImageBytes') &&
        !isPositiveInteger(value.inputConstraints.maxImageBytes))
        return true;
    if (Object.hasOwn(value, 'parameters') && malformedParameters(value.parameters, true))
        return true;
    return (kind === 'ModelProfile' &&
        (typeof value.registration !== 'string' || !validateExpiry('Instant', value.updatedAt).valid));
}
function hasMembers(value, required, allowed) {
    return (required.every(key => Object.hasOwn(value, key)) &&
        Object.keys(value).every(key => allowed.includes(key)));
}
function routeWhitespace(value) {
    const points = Array.from(value);
    const first = points[0]?.codePointAt(0);
    const last = points.at(-1)?.codePointAt(0);
    return ((first !== undefined && OPAQUE_IDENTIFIER_WHITESPACE_CODE_POINTS.includes(first)) ||
        (last !== undefined && OPAQUE_IDENTIFIER_WHITESPACE_CODE_POINTS.includes(last)));
}
function rejected(reason) {
    return Object.freeze({ rejected: reason });
}
export function refMatches(ref, profile, scope) {
    if (ref.origin !== profile.origin || ref.routeName !== profile.routeName)
        return false;
    if (ref.origin === 'official')
        return true;
    if (scope === undefined || ref.scope.layer !== scope.layer)
        return false;
    if (ref.scope.layer === 'organization' && scope.layer === 'organization')
        return ref.scope.organization === scope.organization;
    return (ref.scope.layer === 'tenant' &&
        scope.layer === 'tenant' &&
        tenantIdEquals(ref.scope.tenant, scope.tenant));
}
